svg.title: Driver Dreamer website mockups — v1 comparison
svg.desc: Three complete website mockups with the exact official logo and the same red Ferrari 458 Italia photographic hero. Number one Open Road uses Avenir Next; number two Trackside uses Futura; number three Sunday Drive uses Gill Sans.
svg.text: Official logo · original brand colors · three website directions
